attribution: Credited to the work the manuscript cites, not to OpenAI or the manuscript's authors. The manuscript says: “We use the following results of Kirchberg and Rørdam for the fixed free ultrafilter ω.” Quoted from openai/math (Apache-2.0); AMVO has not consulted or checked the cited work.
scope: Proposition 2.2 (Kirchberg–Rørdam) of the manuscript “The Kirchberg–Rørdam character criterion” (preprints/The-Kirchberg-Rordam-character-criterion-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 299 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a0e2d22982358ba1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The manuscript presents this as a result of other work, which it uses; the attribution names that work in the manuscript's own words. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let A be a nonzero unital separable C∗-algebra. 1. If D ⊂ Fω(A) is separable and contains the ambient unit, then for every m ≥ 1 there is a unital ∗-homomorphism D⊗maxm → Fω(A). 2. A ∼ = A ⊗min Z if and only if Fω(A) contains, with the ambient unit, a separable subhomoge- neous C∗-algebra without characters.
